title: Exact Spectrum of a Curvature-Adapted $\mathbb{Z}_{2}^{3}$ Dunkl--Deng--Fan/Eckart System
summary: This study constructs and exactly solves a curvature-adapted radial Dunkl Hamiltonian for the coordinate-reflection group $\mathbb{Z}*{2}^{3}$ on 3D hyperbolic space, determining how curvature and Dunkl multiplicities govern the discrete spectrum and admissible radial states. The warped-product kinetic operator is defined by its Friedrichs extension, which selects the regular boundary condition in singular radial channels.
